title: Options AI Commentary — Daily Bilingual Snapshot
description: Bilingual (zh + en) AI market commentary for a single trading day. Written after each daily-report run. Version bump policy: schemas/VERSIONING.md.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the commentary was produced.

oneOf.description: Structured: summary + per-ticker keys (e.g. TSLA, AAPL). Values may contain [[pos|neg|key|warn|u:text]] markers.

zh.description: Traditional Chinese AI commentary. String (legacy) or structured dict (new).

oneOf.description: Structured: summary + per-ticker keys. Values may contain [[pos|neg|key|warn|u:text]] markers.

en.description: English AI commentary. String (legacy) or structured dict (new).

model.description: Optional — which Gemini model produced this run (for observability).

_grounding.description: Optional debug field — per-language numeric-grounding check results from the AI generator (assertion that every numeric token in the commentary appears within ε of a token in the truncated quant_report sent to Gemini). Surfaced to the mobile app only in developer mode.
